fields.description: Which platform this account lives on. Part of the record name, so it cannot be changed after creation.
fields.label: Platform
fields.options:
Google Ads
Meta Ads
LinkedIn Ads

fields.description: The platform's own account identifier — Google Ads customer ID, Meta ad account ID, LinkedIn sponsored account ID. Part of the record name, so a re-pull finds the same row instead of creating a second one.
fields.label: External ID

fields.description: Human-readable name as the platform reports it. Refreshed on every sync; safe to leave blank.
fields.label: Account Name

fields.description: Currency the platform reports spend in. Metrics are stored as reported and never converted on ingest — a rate applied at ingest cannot be corrected later.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: Unchecked excludes this account from every sync without deleting its history.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Auth Failed is set on a non-retryable response and pauses this account's syncs, so a dead credential cannot storm the API every night. Cleared by a successful reconnect.
fields.label: Connection Status
fields.options:
Not Connected
Connected
Auth Failed
Disabled

fields.description: Last date fully ingested for this account. Advances only on a clean run — a partial run leaves it alone so the next run re-covers the gap.
fields.label: Sync Cursor
